description: Mobile UI redesign: Netflix-style bottom nav (4 tabs: Home, Browse, Downloads, Profile replacing current 5 tabs), dedicated Browse screen with Genre/Country tabs, Home screen cleanup (hero banner + content rows only, no tab switcher), and language dropdown in header as bottom sheet modal.
steps: Step 1: Redesign bottom tab navigation in apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.jsx. Change from 5 tabs (Home, Movies, TV, Anime, Search) to 4 tabs (Home, Browse, Downloads, Profile). Active tab color: #e50914 (colors.primary). Inactive: #b3b3b3. Remove the existing LanguageSelector from headerRight (will be replaced with globe icon that opens modal). Add a globe icon button in headerRight that opens a language selector modal/bottom sheet. Tab icons: Home (Home icon), Browse (Compass/Grid icon from lucide-react-native), Downloads (Download icon), Profile (User icon).

Step 2: Create the Browse screen at apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/browse.jsx. This NEW screen replaces the search tab. Layout: header area with title (localized 'Browse'/'Jelajahi' etc using useTranslation), tab switcher with 'Genre' and 'Country' tabs using the existing TabBar component pattern. Genre tab: scrollable 2-column grid of genre cards. Each card has genre name (localized), dark background (#1a1a1a), rounded corners, tappable. Use FlatList with numColumns=2. Country tab: same 2-column grid with flag emoji + localized country name. Countries: Korea, Japan, India, USA, Brazil, Mexico, Indonesia, UK, France, Germany, China, Thailand, Turkey, Nigeria. Tap on genre card navigates to a filtered content list (can navigate to movies tab with filter param or a new genre detail route). Tap on country card navigates to filtered content list by country.

Step 3: Create apps/mobile/src/app/genre/[id].jsx - genre detail screen. Shows ContentGrid of content filtered by genre. Uses the getDiscoverByCountry or a genre-filtered endpoint. Header shows genre name. Uses useInfiniteQuery pattern like movies.jsx.

Step 4: Create apps/mobile/src/app/country/[code].jsx - country detail screen. Shows ContentGrid of content filtered by origin country. Uses getDiscoverByCountry(type, countryCode, language, page) from api.js. Header shows country name with flag. Uses useInfiniteQuery pattern.

Step 5: Clean up Home screen (apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/home.jsx). Remove any tab switcher at the top. Keep: hero banner with auto-rotating featured content (already has HeroBanner), horizontal scroll content rows (ContentRail components). The home screen should be a clean vertical scroll of hero + rails only. Remove the 'Browse Movies' empty state button if movies exist.

Step 6: Create the language selector modal component at apps/mobile/src/components/LanguageModal.jsx. Dark theme bottom sheet/modal that slides up. Shows all 7 languages with native names (Bahasa Indonesia, English, Espanol, Portugues, Hindi, Japanese, Korean) and optional flag emoji. Checkmark on currently selected language. Selecting a language calls setLocale from i18n context and closes modal. Style: dark background (#1a1a1a), white text, primary color checkmark.
Step 7: Update the _layout.jsx headerRight to show a globe icon that opens the LanguageModal. Use useState/useRef to control modal visibility. Import the Globe icon from lucide-react-native.

Step 8: Remove the old search.jsx tab file or rename it. Since we're replacing Search with Browse in the tab bar, rename apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/search.jsx to remove it from tabs and create the browse.jsx file instead. Keep search functionality accessible from Browse screen or elsewhere if needed.
Step 9: Create apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/downloads.jsx - placeholder Downloads/My List screen with empty state (download icon, 'Your downloads will appear here' text, dark theme).
Step 10: Create apps/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/profile.jsx - placeholder Profile screen with language selector option, clear cache button, app version. Dark theme.
Step 11: Add skeleton loading states for Browse screen genre/country grids. Create shimmer placeholder cards matching the dark theme (#1a1a1a background with shimmer animation).
Step 12: Update all screen text to use the useTranslation() hook's t() function for localized strings (tab labels, section titles, button text).
acceptance_criteria: Bottom nav shows exactly 4 tabs: Home, Browse, Downloads, Profile
Search tab is removed from bottom nav
Browse screen has Genre/Country tab switcher that works
Genre tab shows 2-column grid of tappable genre cards with localized names
Country tab shows 2-column grid with flag emoji + localized country name for all 14 countries
Tapping genre/country card navigates to filtered content list
Home screen shows hero banner + content rows only, no tab switcher at top
Language selector modal opens from globe icon in header, shows 7 languages
Selecting language in modal triggers immediate UI re-render
All UI text uses i18n t() function
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile && bun install && npx expo export --platform android
